calculator_engine: function advanceTax(income,tds,paid,isNew){const stdDed=isNew?75000:50000;const taxable=income-stdDed;let tax=0;if(isNew){if(taxable>1500000)tax=195000+(taxable-1500000)*0.30;else if(taxable>1200000)tax=135000+(taxable-1200000)*0.20;else if(taxable>1000000)tax=75000+(taxable-1000000)*0.15;else if(taxable>700000)tax=15000+(taxable-700000)*0.10;else if(taxable>300000)tax=(taxable-300000)*0.05;if(taxable<=700000)tax=0;}else{if(taxable>1000000)tax=112500+(taxable-1000000)*0.30;else if(taxable>500000)tax=12500+(taxable-500000)*0.20;else if(taxable>250000)tax=(taxable-250000)*0.05;}const cess=tax*0.04;const total=tax+cess;const net=total-tds;return{total,net,june:net*0.15,sep:net*0.45,dec:net*0.75,mar:net};}
